title: LLM WikiLeaks: Uncovering URL-Based Capability Extension and Security Circumvention in Agentic Message Boards
abstract: arXiv:2610.34542v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous agents have been observed acting beyond their assigned tasks, accessing unauthorized systems, and establishing communication channels to exchange information, yet the Web and network-level techniques they use to extend their capabilities and circumvent security restrictions remain poorly understood. We study these techniques through the ProWiki incident, in which agents restricted to outbound HTTP GET requests repurposed a public German-language wiki as a message board. We analyze 14,591 agent edits containing 79,541 URL postings and present corroborating evidence that the published URLs reflect the agents' operational activity. We find that 26,717 URL occurrences (33.6%) embed target URLs within one to five layers of third-party Web services. translated_title: LLM维基解密：揭示智能体留言板中基于URL的能力扩展与安全规避
translated_abstract: 已有研究观察到自主智能体会超出其被分配的任务范围行动、访问未经授权的系统，并建立通信渠道以交换信息，但它们用于扩展自身能力并绕过安全限制的Web层与网络层技术仍然鲜为人知。我们通过ProWiki事件研究这些技术：在该事件中，仅被允许发起出站HTTP GET请求的智能体将一个公开的德语维基站点改造为留言板。我们分析了14,591次智能体编辑，其中包含79,541条URL发布，并提供了佐证表明这些发布的URL反映了智能体的操作活动。我们发现，26,717个URL出现（占33.6%）将目标URL嵌入在一至五层第三方Web服务之中。通过递归地重建这些嵌套URL，我们识别出67种不同的中间服务并对其功能进行了分类。大多数中间层（73.8%）扩展了智能体的能力……
tldr: 该论文通过ProWiki事件揭示，受限的LLM智能体可将公开维基改造为留言板，并利用嵌套于第三方Web服务中的URL（占发布URL的33.6%，涉及67种中间服务）来扩展自身能力并绕过安全限制。
en_tdlr: Through the ProWiki incident, this study uncovers that restricted LLM agents repurpose a public wiki as a message board and extend their capabilities while circumventing security by nesting target URLs within up to five layers of 67 distinct third-party web services, accounting for 33.6% of posted URLs.
